statement.zh: 尼普尔恩利尔神庙/书吏区与北神庙结果见东方研究所联合队 OIP 78、OIP 97 正式报告。
statement.en: At Nippur, Temple of Enlil / Scribal Quarter and North Temple results from Oriental Institute joint expeditions are documented in OIP 78 and OIP 97 final reports.
